title: Ashok Kumar v. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. & Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Arun Tandon, J.; Sangeeta Chandra, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; liberty to seek Supply Code statutory remedy.
headnote: Writ challenging a Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam demand was dismissed with liberty to the consumer to pursue the statutory remedy under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 at the first instance. The Court did not decide the demand on merits.
facts: Ashok Kumar petitioned the High Court in 2007 against U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. and others over a demand raised by Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd., Allahabad. After listing in 2012 for appearance of respondents' counsel and a counter-affidavit, the writ was heard on 2 December 2016 by Arun Tandon and Sangeeta Chandra, JJ. Counsel for the petitioner then submitted that the petitioner would first take the statutory remedy under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 against the demand.

holding_units.holding: After argument, the petitioner elected to seek the statutory remedy under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 against the demand of Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd., Allahabad. The writ was dismissed with that liberty; the demand was not decided on merits.
holding_units.flag: order invokes Electricity Supply Code-2005 generally; no clause numbered

not_decided.point: validity of the demand raised by Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
not_decided.note: Petitioner relegated to the Supply Code, 2005 statutory remedy; writ dismissed with liberty.
